email.subject: Vindication
email.body:
We're ready.
I need you to do a takedown. As you might have guessed, most before this was just to get you up to speed - here's where it really starts. When you run "Sequencer", it's going to activate a script I've left on one of my servers. It'll open a connection to a web server, and I want that server destroyed - go in there and delete everything in the /sys/ folder.
This isn't going to be quite like before - that server's hidden for a reason. It's going to have tracers on it in a big way. What's where sequencer helps - It'll be keeping that connection open as long as it can, and feeding your UI a guide on how much time you've got. Make sure you keep it running.
Details attached, as always. For now, this'll be the last you hear of me - either way this build was meant to be temporary - a holdover to set things up for the real thing.
Good luck. Fight. --Bit 0
